states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Scene initializes with brain and lanterns loaded, equal energy distribution (20 units each), no selection

states.name: First Lantern Selected
states.description: User has clicked and selected the first lantern, ready for energy adjustment

states.name: Energy Redistributed
states.description: Energy slider adjusted, causing multi-lantern coupling where total remains 100 units

states.name: High Concentration
states.description: One lantern allocated maximum energy (50 units), others proportionally reduced

states.name: Balanced Illumination

states.name: Minimal Stimulation

states.name: Stability Verification
states.description: System maintains energy conservation and illumination state over extended period

action.code: const lanterns = window.scene.children.filter(c => c.userData.isLantern); if (lanterns[0]) { const event = new MouseEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth/2, clientY: window.innerHeight/2, bubbles: true}); window.dispatchEvent(event); setTimeout(() => { const rect = window.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect(); const mouse = new window.THREE.Vector2(0, 0); window.raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, window.camera); const intersects = window.raycaster.intersectObjects(lanterns, true); if (intersects.length > 0) { let obj = intersects[0].object; while (obj.parent && !obj.userData.isLantern) obj = obj.parent; if (obj.userData.isLantern) { window.__3D_STATE__.selectedLanternIndex = obj.userData.lanternIndex; obj.traverse(n => { if (n.isMesh) n.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.5; }); } } }, 100); }

postconditions: First lantern is selected and highlighted
selectedLanternIndex is set to 0
Lantern shows visual selection feedback

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (slider) { slider.value = 35; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Selected lantern energy increased to 35 units
Other lanterns' energies proportionally decreased
Total energy budget remains exactly 100 units

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (slider) { slider.value = 50; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Selected lantern reaches maximum energy allocation (50 units)
Remaining 50 units distributed across other 4 lanterns
Brain illumination shows concentrated effect from dominant source

action.code: const lanterns = window.scene.children.filter(c => c.userData.isLantern); for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(3, lanterns.length); i++) { const lantern = lanterns[i]; const event = new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true}); window.dispatchEvent(event); setTimeout(() => { window.__3D_STATE__.selectedLanternIndex = i; lantern.traverse(n => { if (n.isMesh) n.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.5; }); const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (slider) { slider.value = 20 + i * 5; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, i * 400); }

postconditions: At least 3 lanterns have energy above 10 units
Energy distributed more evenly across multiple sources
Brain receives balanced multi-region illumination

action.code: const lanterns = window.scene.children.filter(c => c.userData.isLantern); for (let i = 1; i < lanterns.length; i++) { setTimeout(() => { window.__3D_STATE__.selectedLanternIndex = i; const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (slider) { slider.value = 5; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, i * 300); }

postconditions: Most lanterns reduced to minimal energy (< 10 units)
Only 1-2 lanterns remain as active stimulation sources
Brain illumination significantly reduced

action.code: const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (slider) { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { setTimeout(() => { window.__3D_STATE__.selectedLanternIndex = i; slider.value = 18 + i * 2; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }, i * 400); } }

postconditions: Energy redistributed to reactivate multiple lanterns
At least 3 lanterns above 10 units threshold
System demonstrates reversible energy allocation
Energy conservation maintained over 60 second period
Total energy budget remains exactly 100 units
Lantern illumination states remain stable
No energy drift or numerical instability
